turns.text: 9:54 pm update. two things tonight, please. first, i need to schedule daycare tours. we got a spot at a center on pell road starting jan 5, and i want to book the tours for a weekday when my wife is at work, she has enough on her plate and doesn't need to think about this one. she leaves on the 7:20 train and is home around 6. can you help me pick a day and a time window?

Happy to. Since she's out from about 7:20 a.m. until around 6 p.m., any weekday works. Here's a simple way to schedule it:

| Slot | Why it works |
|---|---|
| 9:00-10:30 a.m. | Right after a morning nap, so your baby is alert |
| 1:30-3:00 p.m. | After the midday nap, before the evening fussiness |

Tips:
- Pick a weekday that isn't a holiday so the center is running normally. Tours are most useful when you can see the rooms in use.
- Ask for back-to-back tours if you're visiting more than one center, with 45 minutes between them for travel and a feed.
- Questions to bring: infant ratios, sick policy, how they handle bottles and naps, pickup flexibility, and what's included in the monthly fee.

If you tell me which days you're free and how many centers you're visiting, I can lay out a specific schedule and draft the booking messages.
